terrain_type.description: Ground surface type. Assessed from camera view of floor. Allowed types are common indoor residential and commercial surfaces. Prohibited types include high-pile carpet, outdoor terrain, or unstable surfaces.

obstacle_density.description: Fraction of BEV (Bird's-Eye View) area occupied by obstacles (0-1). Computed from BEV occupancy map, not camera. High values represent significant clutter. ODD limit is set to 0.7 to allow for dense furniture but exclude impassable clutter.
